description: The native answer to one decision. It enters from the edge it belongs to, it is draggable, and on a phone it replaces the centred dialog outright.

MUST: Compose the overlay primitive for its trap, its exclusion, its restore and its labelled barrier.
Render at the modal tier, over the overlay scrim.
Show a visible grabber whenever it is draggable.
Dismiss on travel past the specified fraction of its height, or on a release above the specified velocity.
Return to rest on the spatial spring when a drag is released under both thresholds, leaving no trace.
Drive position from a single source, so entry, drag, return and exit cannot fight.
Enter on the modal-enter role and exit one step shorter.
Keep a close affordance that does not require the gesture.
SHOULD: Centre and detach from the edges once the layout is medium or wider, at the sheet container width.
Take the largest radius steps — a sheet is a large surface, and radius scales with size.
NEVER: Drive entry from a keyframe animation while a gesture drives position. Re-adding the animation restarts it from its first frame.
Stack a sheet on a sheet.
Claim an edge swipe for dismissal.
